page_title: BET 1-0 ATM | Betis v Atletico Madrid 27/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for full time as Jesus Gil Manzano ends the second half.

90+6' Julian Alvarez nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
90+5' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.

90+4' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Atl. Madrid are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
90+1' Substitution. Aitor Ruibal makes way for Youssouf Sabaly (Betis).
90+1' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to substitute Abde Ezzalzouli and he is replaced by Iker Losada (Betis).
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
88' Although Adrian (Betis) is just on the bench, Jesus Gil Manzano has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
88' Manuel Pellegrini is stunned as referee Jesus Gil Manzano shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
85' The attendance for today's match is 52621.
84' Thomas Lemar (Atl. Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Rodrigo de Paul.
84' The free kick is taken by Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid), but ball is cleared. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
83' The yellow card is received by Aitor Ruibal (Betis).
82' Betis are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
80' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) fires a rebound from close range onto the left post!
77' Chimy Avila comes off the pitch to be replaced by Assane Diao (Betis).
75' Jesus Gil Manzano shows a yellow card to Romain Perraud (Betis) for his blatant foul.
75' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
74' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
74' The ball is cleared after Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid win a corner kick.
72' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
72' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee signals a corner kick to Atl. Madrid.
70' Diego Simeone has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) replacing Antoine Griezmann.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) is coming onto the pitch as Samuel Lino cannot continue after picking up an injury.
69' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Betis comes to nothing.
69' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Chimy Avila (Betis), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. Good work from Betis as they win a corner.
68' Referee Jesus Gil Manzano reverses his original decision after the VAR review. There was no infringement and subsequently it’s not a penalty.
68' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Betis using VAR. Let's see what happens.
66' The referee shows a yellow card to Koke (Atl. Madrid). No wonder. A clear yellow for bad language.
66' Jesus Gil Manzano has a clear sight and sees a foul from Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid). The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to Betis.
65' Vitor Roque (Betis) spurns a big chance! He gets to the rebound but only hits the crossbar!
64' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
62' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is behind the touchline and Atl. Madrid will take a throw-in.

59' A clever short pass gives Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
58' Jan Oblak blocks a long-range effort from Chimy Avila (Betis) towards the right side of the goal.
56' Wonderful movement by Atl. Madrid. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
53' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

53' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the roof of the net, but is thwarted by a great save from Rui Silva. The ball goes out of play. Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
51' Pablo Fornals (Betis) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
50' The resulting corner, taken by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid), comes to nothing.

49' Great save! Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom left corner was brilliantly saved by Rui Silva. The linesman makes the right call and Atl. Madrid will have a corner.

48' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Reinildo Mandava is replaced by Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid).
46' Diego Simeone makes a switch. Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is coming on in place of Conor Gallagher at the start of the second period.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
44' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
44' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Atl. Madrid.
43' Vitor Roque (Betis) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid will have a throw-in.
40' The resulting corner from Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

40' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner.
38' Chimy Avila (Betis) whips the ball into the box and Vitor Roque takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.
35' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

34' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Chimy Avila (Betis) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. The referee points to the corner flag and Betis will take a corner.
34' Vitor Roque (Betis) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.

32' Chimy Avila (Betis) get himself out of a tight corner inside the box then shoots. The keeper leaps for the ball but it flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.

30' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Vitor Roque (Betis) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
30' Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
29' Corner kick. Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is ready to send the ball into the box.

29' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atl. Madrid.
28' A long ball forward to Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) is intercepted. Atl. Madrid win a corner.
27' What a chance that is! Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the crossbar!

26' That's a well-taken pass by Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis). He unleashes a strike from the edge of the box, but blazes it high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.

25' An accurate cross finds its way to Chimy Avila (Betis) who sends in a bullet header towards the middle of the target from just outside the box. The ball bounces up off the ground but the goalkeeper saves.
24' Pablo Fornals (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
22' Half-chance! Sergi Altimira (Betis) plays a pass into the box, but Jan Oblak reacts well to snuff out the attack.
19' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
18' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Rui Silva easily deals with the threat.
17' Sergi Altimira (Betis) jumps into a tackle and Jesus Gil Manzano signals a foul. Atl. Madrid are awarded the free kick.

16' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) is untouchable as he tricks his way into the box. His shot, though, lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies a whisker wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
14' Wonderful pass from Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) for Antoine Griezmann, but they can't profit from it as Rui Silva comes off his line to collect.
12' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

10' A short pass finds Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
7' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Betis, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
7' Reinildo Mandava (Atl. Madrid) has tested the patience of referee Jesus Gil Manzano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
6' Vitor Roque (Betis) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
4' 1 - 0 Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) puts the ball past his own goalkeeper.
2' Atl. Madrid showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. The linesman signals a throw-in for Betis.
1' The first half has started.
Betis will kick-off.
Jesus Gil Manzano is introduced as the referee for today's match.
